paragraphs: Rabbi Yose ben Yaakov of Kfar Ono.
In Zohar, Shemot 10b, he asks Rabbi Meir a question.

notes.text: The abbreviated name ר״מ is not resolved here. A source lookup using Zohar2:10b failed to resolve that reference and supplies no evidence for an expansion.

The saved named Vocalized Zohar, Israel 2013, Shemot selection explicitly names Yose son of Rabbi Yaakov of Kfar Ono asking Rabbi Meir. This supports contextual Meir for supplied ר״מ, despite the earlier unsuccessful request. The source י: is retained as 10b; the saved selection does not independently map that edition pagination or establish a broader historical identity.

The HaSulam edition places the question at Zohar, Shemot 10b, in section 168. It names Rabbi Yose ben Yaakov of Kfar Ono as the questioner and Rabbi Meir as the person he asks, confirming the reading of Hyman’s initials ר״מ in this passage.
